answer: What keeps this honest is network flow fingerprint per device, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. Cloning 554 keys multiplies the price 554-fold: 64264 POA locked, or 9972 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. Hold the lagoon up to the light, weigh the delta of the attack, and keep the bridge of the verdict where everyone can audit it. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
